items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know much about John; he was a nice fellow so far as I was concerned... I stayed in his house in Pennsylvania

ctx.x: How about John Kelley? Al's brother?
Well, John Kelley was -- I didn't know much about John; he was a nice fellow so far as I was concerned, but he had nothing to do with the band, you might as well say, you know?
We get a Christmas card from him every year.
